propositions: The code-review tests overlay is currently selected only by glob match on test files, missing cases where product code is added without corresponding test files, allowing defects to merge uncaught.

The content_triggered_overlays function receives only diff text and repo root, making it unable to check whether changed files match the tests globs, so no content-based rule can enforce the 'no test file changed' half of the trigger.

An added declaration can be detected from diff content by matching ADDED lines against an existing polyglot regex (_REMOVED_DECL_RE) for declarations, extracting the declared name, and verifying it is not also removed in the same file to suppress annotation-only rewrites.

The tests overlay must be selected when a changed source file contains an added declaration and no changed file matches the tests globs, unifying both glob-triggered and content-triggered paths through overlay_union.

Guard (vii) in code-review-tests.md must narrow blocking eligibility to findings concerning newly-introduced behaviour (implementing lines appear as ADDED in the diff) with named violating inputs (concrete values stated verbatim), changing eligibility for both existing and new trigger populations.

The trigger must be portable across languages and repository layouts, reusing the existing polyglot declaration regex and applying only universal path predicates (tests globs plus docs/data extension skip), not Python-only or src/-only rules.
